title: ttll-p3: analysis code for Truong Tho Living Lab Paper 3

creators.name: Lê, Ngọc Hiếu

description: Analysis code and aggregate outputs for Truong Tho Living Lab Paper 3. The repository is software, not the manuscript. Full spatial replication requires authorized survey coordinates and external Geofabrik PBF snapshots.
